name: punchlist-axi
description: Click-to-edit for any running web app: a proxy injects a picker, your coding agent pulls the batch of notes and edits the source.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=scripts/punchlist.mjs --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node
// Generated from src/cli.mjs by `npm run build` - do not edit.'
scripts.test: node test/proxy.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs && node test/drag.test.mjs
